## Symp_101 Library Gene Pickup

Symp_101 is the single guide library to measure the Cas13d efficiency. we will pick up genes with different essentially, expression and copy number and pick guideRNAs against them.
The first batch of Work Package 1 consist of 10 Lung cancer lines. but for the initial optimization we picked 3 cell lines= A549, NCIH1299, NCIH1975.
below I will filter all data initially for the 10 cell lines selected for WP1, but all the downstream analyses will focus only three selected lines.

I obtained all data from DepMap (May 2023)
cleaned-up data first
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(reshape2)
library(ggpubr)
library(here)
set.seed(427)
```
## filter target cell lines

```{r}
target_lines<- read.csv(file="../input/symp_1st_batch.txt")
target_lines
model<- read.csv(file="../input/Model.csv")
model_selected<- model %>% filter(StrippedCellLineName %in% target_lines$cell_line) %>% droplevels()
```





```{r}
gene_effect<- read_csv(file = "../input/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv")
head(names(gene_effect))
m<- names(gene_effect)
m <- gsub(x = m, pattern = "\\s", replacement = "_")
m<- gsub(x = m, pattern="\\(|\\)", replacement="")
names(gene_effect)<-m
head(names(gene_effect))
filtered_gene_effect<- gene_effect %>% filter(ModelID %in% model_selected$ModelID) %>% droplevels()
random_gene_effect<- sample_n(gene_effect, 10)


filtered_gene_effect<- do.call(data.frame, filtered_gene_effect)
random_gene_effect<- do.call(data.frame, random_gene_effect)
combined_gene_effect<-rbind(filtered_gene_effect, random_gene_effect)
melted_combined_gene_effect<-melt(combined_gene_effect)
melted_combined_gene_effect<- melted_combined_gene_effect %>% separate(variable, into=c("Gene", "Gene_ID"), sep="_")
melted_combined_gene_effect$Data<- "Crs"

gene_effect_long <- setNames(data.frame(t(combined_gene_effect[ , - 1])), combined_gene_effect[ , 1])
gene_effect_long$Gene<- rownames(gene_effect_long )
gene_effect_long<- gene_effect_long %>% separate(Gene, into=c("Gene", "Gene_ID"), sep="_")
head(gene_effect_long)

write_csv(melted_combined_gene_effect, file=paste0("../Cleaned_up_data/melted_combined_gene_effect", Sys.Date(),".csv"))
write_csv(gene_effect_long, file="../Cleaned_up_data/target_random_lines_gene_effect.csv")



```
### Gene expression
Gene expression TPM values of the protein coding genes for DepMap cell lines. Values are inferred from RNA-seq data using the RSEM tool and are reported after log2 transformation, using a pseudo-count of 1; log2(TPM+1).

```{r}
gene_expression<- read_csv(file="../input/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1.csv")

head(names(gene_expression))
m<- names(gene_expression)
m <- gsub(x = m, pattern = "\\s", replacement = "_")
m<- gsub(x = m, pattern="\\(|\\)", replacement="")
names(gene_expression)<-m
names(gene_expression)[1]<- c("ModelID")

gene_expression<- do.call(data.frame, gene_expression)
combined_gene_expression<- gene_expression %>% filter(ModelID %in% melted_combined_gene_effect$ModelID) %>% droplevels()
melted_combined_gene_expression<-melt(combined_gene_expression)
melted_combined_gene_expression<- melted_combined_gene_expression %>% separate(variable, into=c("Gene", "Gene_ID"), sep="_")
melted_combined_gene_expression$Data<- "Exp"


gene_expression_long <- setNames(data.frame(t(combined_gene_expression[ , - 1])), combined_gene_expression[ , 1])
gene_expression_long$Gene<- rownames(gene_expression_long )
gene_expression_long<- gene_expression_long %>% separate(Gene, into=c("Gene", "Gene_ID"), sep="_")
head(gene_expression_long)

write_csv(melted_combined_gene_expression, file=paste0("../Cleaned_up_data/melted_combined_gene_expression", Sys.Date(),".csv"))
write_csv(gene_expression_long, file="../Cleaned_up_data/target_random_lines_gene_expression.csv")

```


## gene copy number
explanation from depmap 
(Gene-level copy number data that is log2 transformed with a pseudo-count of 1; log2(CN ratio + 1) . Inferred from WGS, WES or SNP array depending on the availability of the data type. Values are calculated by mapping genes onto the segment level calls and computing a weighted average along the genomic coordinate.)
```{r}
gene_copy<- read_csv(file="../input/OmicsCNGene.csv")

head(names(gene_copy))
m<- names(gene_copy)

m <- gsub(x = m, pattern = "\\s", replacement = "_")
m<- gsub(x = m, pattern="\\(|\\)", replacement="")
names(gene_copy)<-m
names(gene_copy)[1]<- c("ModelID")
gene_copy<- do.call(data.frame, gene_copy)
combined_gene_copy<- gene_copy %>% filter(ModelID %in% melted_combined_gene_effect$ModelID) %>% droplevels()
melted_combined_gene_copy<-melt(combined_gene_copy)
melted_combined_gene_copy<- melted_combined_gene_copy %>% separate(variable, into=c("Gene", "Gene_ID"), sep="_")
melted_combined_gene_copy$Data<- "Copy"


gene_copy_long <- setNames(data.frame(t(combined_gene_copy[ , - 1])), combined_gene_copy[ , 1])
gene_copy_long$Gene<- rownames(gene_copy_long )
gene_copy_long<- gene_copy_long %>% separate(Gene, into=c("Gene", "Gene_ID"), sep="_")
head(gene_copy_long)

write_csv(melted_combined_gene_copy, file=paste0("../Cleaned_up_data/melted_combined_gene_copy",Sys.Date(),".csv"))
write_csv(gene_copy_long, file="../Cleaned_up_data/target_random_lines_gene_copy.csv")

```

### compare gene effect and gene dependency
Post-Chronos Gene dependency probability estimates for all models in the integrated gene effect. - Columns: Gene - Rows: ModelID

```{r}
gene_dep<- read_csv(file="../input/CRISPRGeneDependency.csv")
n<- names(gene_dep)
head(n)
n <- gsub(x = n, pattern = "\\s", replacement = "_")
n<- gsub(x = n, pattern="\\(|\\)", replacement="")
head(n)
names(gene_dep)<-n
gene_dep<- do.call(data.frame,gene_dep)
combined_gene_dep<- gene_dep %>% filter(ModelID %in% melted_combined_gene_effect$ModelID) %>% droplevels()
melted_combined_gene_dep<-melt(combined_gene_dep)
melted_combined_gene_dep<- melted_combined_gene_dep %>% separate(variable, into=c("Gene", "Gene_ID"), sep="_")
melted_combined_gene_dep$Data<- "Dep"



gene_dep_long <- setNames(data.frame(t(combined_gene_dep[ , - 1])), combined_gene_dep[ , 1])
gene_dep_long$Gene<- rownames(gene_dep_long)
gene_dep_long<- gene_dep_long %>%  separate(Gene, into=c("Gene", "Gene_ID"), sep="_")

write_csv(melted_combined_gene_dep, file="../Cleaned_up_data/melted_combined_gene_dep.csv")
write_csv(gene_dep_long, file="../Cleaned_up_data/target_random_lines_gene_dep.csv")



```

### Put together all data for selected cell lines and annotate
essential and non essential genes are Hart essentials

```{r}

all_data<- rbind(melted_combined_gene_effect, melted_combined_gene_expression, melted_combined_gene_copy, melted_combined_gene_dep)

ceg_neg<- read_tsv(file="../input/CEG_NEG.txt")
names(ceg_neg)<- c("Gene", "func")

all_data <- left_join(all_data, ceg_neg, by="Gene")
names(all_data)
all_data<-all_data %>% mutate(Func= case_when(
  is.na(func) ~ "Other",
  TRUE ~ as.character(func)))
selected_model_data<- model %>% select(ModelID, StrippedCellLineName, CCLEName, contains("Onco"))
all_data<-left_join(all_data, selected_model_data, by="ModelID")

names(all_data)
summary(all_data)

all_data<-all_data %>%  mutate(model_type="Target") %>% mutate(model_type=case_when(
  OncotreePrimaryDisease!="Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer" ~"Random",
  TRUE ~ as.character(model_type)))
all_data<- do.call(data.frame,all_data)

write_csv(all_data, file=paste0("../Cleaned_up_data/all_melted_data", Sys.Date(),".csv"))

plot_1<- all_data %>% filter(Data=="Crs") %>% filter(model_type=="Target") %>% ggplot(aes(x=StrippedCellLineName,y=value ))+geom_boxplot(color="red",fill="Pink")+theme_bw()+ylab("Gene_Effect")+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90))+ggtitle("Target")
plot_2<- all_data %>% filter(Data=="Crs") %>% filter(model_type=="Random") %>% ggplot(aes(x=StrippedCellLineName,y=value))+geom_boxplot(color="DarkBlue",fill="LightBlue")+theme_bw()+ylab("Gene_Effect")+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90),axis.title.y = element_blank())+ggtitle("Random")
ggarrange(plot_1,plot_2)

plot_3<- all_data %>% filter(Data=="Exp") %>% filter(model_type=="Target") %>% ggplot(aes(x=StrippedCellLineName,y=value ))+geom_boxplot(color="red",fill="Pink")+theme_bw()+ylab("Log2(TPM")+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90))+ggtitle("Target")

plot_4<- all_data %>% filter(Data=="Exp") %>% filter(model_type=="Random") %>% ggplot(aes(x=StrippedCellLineName,y=value))+geom_boxplot(color="DarkBlue",fill="LightBlue")+theme_bw()+ylab("Log2(TPM")+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90),axis.title.y = element_blank())+ggtitle("Random")
ggarrange(plot_3,plot_4)

plot_5<- all_data %>% filter(Data=="Copy") %>% filter(model_type=="Target") %>% ggplot(aes(x=StrippedCellLineName,y=value ))+geom_boxplot(color="red",fill="Pink")+theme_bw()+ylab("log2(Copy number)")+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90))+ggtitle("Target")

plot_6<- all_data %>% filter(Data=="Copy") %>% filter(model_type=="Random") %>% ggplot(aes(x=StrippedCellLineName,y=value))+geom_boxplot(color="DarkBlue",fill="LightBlue")+theme_bw()+ylab("Copy Number")+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90),axis.title.y = element_blank())+ggtitle("Random")
ggarrange(plot_5,plot_6)

plot_7<- all_data %>% filter(Data=="Dep") %>% filter(model_type=="Target") %>% ggplot(aes(x=StrippedCellLineName,y=value ))+geom_boxplot(color="red",fill="Pink")+theme_bw()+ylab("Gene Dependency")+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90))+ggtitle("Target")
plot_8<- all_data %>% filter(Data=="Dep") %>% filter(model_type=="Random") %>% ggplot(aes(x=StrippedCellLineName,y=value))+geom_boxplot(color="DarkBlue",fill="LightBlue")+theme_bw()+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90),axis.title.y = element_blank())+ggtitle("Random")
ggarrange(plot_7,plot_8)

```

combine data for initial 3 cell lines (A549, NCIH1299 and NCIH1975 )
```{r}
# Select relevant columns from each dataset
exp <- gene_expression_long %>% select(Gene, NCIH1299_Exp = "ACH-000510", NCIH1975_Exp = "ACH-000587", A549_Exp = "ACH-000681")
eff <- gene_effect_long %>% select(Gene, NCIH1299_Crs = "ACH-000510", NCIH1975_Crs = "ACH-000587", A549_Crs = "ACH-000681")
copy <- gene_copy_long %>% select(Gene, NCIH1299_Copy = "ACH-000510", NCIH1975_Copy = "ACH-000587", A549_Copy = "ACH-000681")
dep <- gene_dep_long %>% select(Gene, NCIH1299_dep = "ACH-000510", NCIH1975_dep = "ACH-000587", A549_dep = "ACH-000681")

# Summary of expression data
summary(exp)

# Merge all datasets sequentially
all_data_target <- list(exp, eff, copy, dep) %>%
  reduce(inner_join, by = "Gene") %>%
  left_join(ceg_neg, by = "Gene")

all_data_target<- all_data_target %>% mutate(func= case_when(
  is.na(func) ~ "Other",
  TRUE ~ as.character(func)))
head(all_data_target)
all_data_target<-do.call(data.frame,all_data_target)

## save all target data
write_csv(all_data_target, file=paste0("../Cleaned_up_data/all_data_target_", Sys.Date(),".csv"))
write_csv(exp, file=paste0("../Cleaned_up_data/exp_data_target_", Sys.Date(),".csv"))
write_csv(eff, file=paste0("../Cleaned_up_data/crispr_data_target_", Sys.Date(),".csv"))
write_csv(copy, file=paste0("../Cleaned_up_data/copy_data_target_", Sys.Date(),".csv"))
write_csv(dep, file=paste0("../Cleaned_up_data/dependency_data_target_", Sys.Date(),".csv"))

```
